The map, plate px to this print's px: x' = 0.96224 x - 0.00318 y - 35.555, y' = 0.00444 x + 0.95336 y - 162.824, a scale of 0.962 across and 0.953 down (the copy was resampled 0.93 % wider than tall, hence pixel_aspect 1.0093) and a turn of about 0.23 degrees, which this camera leaves out (under 2 px at the print's edges). So the eye and heading are the plate's (u 22.5, v 14.45, 1.05 m over grade, yaw -90), the principal point is the plate's (689, 774) carried through the map, (625.0, 578.1), and the focal length is the plate's 659 px times the vertical scale, 628.3 px. Everything the plate's camera reads, and every way it misses (T-3079's flank), it reads and misses here.
